name: forge
description: Engineering workflow for one repository in GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code (GitHub by default, or Forgejo with tea: issues, pull requests, and CI): full research and investigation for every new ticket, revision-aware review gates with one plain document each, named ticket worktrees and session titles, a ticket board skill for any session, and a repository wiki. Forge reads only the full-v4 ticket layout. Say 'set up forge' to seed the config in the repository wiki.
